description: A 0.6 mm roof (and so a 2.6 mm cavity in the 3.2 mm body): blocker. Only hand-written measurements have one today: the evaluator builds the standard roof or minRoofMm, whichever is larger, and thickens it under a deboss.

findings.fix: build the part again for process `fdm-0.4`: the evaluator makes the roof the standard roof or minRoofMm, whichever is larger, and thickens it under a deboss or serial rather than thinning it, so the rebuilt roof is at least 1 mm
findings.message: the roof is 0.6 mm thick, below the 1 mm minimum roof of process `fdm-0.4`
